verdict.rationale: Obsidian has no first-party AI connector. It does support a community plugin ecosystem for integrating third-party services (obsidian-docs-7), and a hands-on user reports AI plugins such as Text-Generator work as a productive LLM interface, though none offer decent RAG (obsidian-comm-7). Plain local Markdown files and headless Sync, described as 'useful for agents', also give external AI tools a route to the notes. missing for 10: a first-party AI/LLM connector or official MCP integration, documented AI plugins with retrieval/RAG over the vault, and broader independent corroboration of the AI plugin ecosystem.
